metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. KODAK technical data H-1-5294 (2019 (Revised 5-24)), KODAK-EKTACHROME-100D-COLOR-REVERSAL-FILM-5294-7294-datasheet-EN.pdf, PDF page(s) 3;4, KODAK EKTACHROME 100D Color Reversal Film 5294 / 7294: https://filmcolors.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/KODAK-EKTACHROME-100D-COLOR-REVERSAL-FILM-5294-7294-datasheet-EN.pdf (catalogued at https://filmcolors.org/timeline-entry/40486/) Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): dye densities outside the printed 400-700 nm (held below, exponential decay above); the printed dyes are peak-normalised, their relative amounts come from the builder's neutral balance; sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; the density at which sensitivity is defined is not stated (1.0 assumed); hanatos2025 adaptation parameters (averaged from pinned Kodak reversal profiles); interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet).
